company.name: InvoiceQ
company.shortDescription: InvoiceQ provides electronic invoicing systems and integration solutions to eliminate the need for paper invoices.
company.description: InvoiceQ is a SaaS-based e-invoicing Platform that can be integrated with client ERP systems. It automates manual tasks to increase efficiency, minimize error handling, and help businesses comply with e-invoicing regulations. InvoiceQ seamlessly integrates with various business systems, making it easier to manage invoices without being restricted by technical obstacles.

productsAndServices.description: A fully electronic invoicing platform that supports businesses of any size with invoice issuance, management, and compliance with local regulations.
productsAndServices.name: Electronic Invoicing Platform

productsAndServices.description: Provides integration with various internal systems including Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, Xero, JD Edwards, and SAP, ensuring seamless data synchronization and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Integration Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Manages detailed records of ordered items, including quantities, order dates, prices, and integrates them into inventory systems upon delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Import Stock Management

productsAndServices.description: Administers products and goods sold, generates export invoices, and ensures compliance with organizational rules and regulations.
productsAndServices.name: Export Stock Management

productsAndServices.description: Tracks details about damaged items and their causes, providing accurate estimations and detailed numbers for finance and accounting departments.
productsAndServices.name: Stock Damage Management

productsAndServices.description: Generates reports for item movement tracking, import/export dates, current stock levels, performance rates, and department reports to promote accuracy and efficiency.
productsAndServices.name: Reports

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,200,000, or 48.19% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,166,597 to $11,200,944, a 5.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
